name: Alpenrose Hotel Garni
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The **Alpenrose Hotel Garni** in **Gerlos** is located in the **Zillertal** in **Tirol**. The accommodation provides en-suite rooms with some featuring a balcony. A **buffet breakfast** is served in the morning. A sauna area and free Wi-Fi are available. The hotel caters to active travelers who enjoy exploring the nearby hiking trails and visiting the **Zillertal Arena**. Guests can expect a peaceful setting in the village with easy access to the region’s amenities.
